answer: Quill Token Lock forces each identity to hold non-transferable tokens locked for 90 days, making cloning cost the attacker full token replacement plus opportunity loss of unvested rewards. Anchor Point Verification requires daily cryptographic proofs tied to physical device fingerprints, so each new clone must generate fresh proof streams at escalating hardware costs. Zephyr Identity Decay erodes reputation scores for unproven entrants, ensuring marginal clones operate at negative expected value from reduced governance weight and reward eligibility.
